# Noto Sans CJK SC fixture font

Unmodified `NotoSansCJKsc-Regular.otf` from the official `notofonts/noto-cjk`
Sans2.004 tag, resolved commit `523d033d6cb47f4a80c58a35753646f5c3608a78`.
Source: `Sans/OTF/SimplifiedChinese/NotoSansCJKsc-Regular.otf` at that commit.
The upstream root `LICENSE` is preserved in `source/` (SIL Open Font License 1.1).

16,437,364 bytes; SHA-256
`2c76254f6fc379fddfce0a7e84fb5385bb135d3e399294f6eeb6680d0365b74b`.
Both files are locked in `third_party/manifest.json`; ordinary builds never fetch
or substitute a system font. This is a deterministic UI sans candidate, not a
claim to reproduce the game's SimSun/system-font appearance.

The full OTF is used for correctness evidence. Subsetting, font streaming,
production atlas and mobile memory/performance budgets remain unverified.
